svg.desc: RK4 geodesic is revealed against an exact great-circle oracle. s is an integration/geodesic parameter, not physical time.
svg.text: Numerical RK4 trajectory against exact great circle
s = geodesic/integration parameter · not physical time
r(s)=r₀ cos s + v₀ sin s
Boundary: numerical agreement verifies this implementation; the path is not an infrastructure trajectory.
